Based on the image provided, here is the analysis of each magenta square:

*   **Top-Left Cluster (Sky/Tree area):** These squares are highlighting **parts of a normal block texture**. Specifically, they are marking the green pixels on the side of a grass block and potentially some leaves or the edge of the tree trunk. They are not floating particles; they are static parts of the world geometry.
*   **Middle-Left Cluster (On the tree trunk):** This square is placed directly on the **bark texture of a tree trunk (log)**. It is detecting the brown, pixelated pattern of the wood. This is a solid block, not a particle.
*   **Bottom Cluster (Hotbar/Inventory):** These squares are highlighting **item icons in your inventory hotbar**.
    *   The squares on the left are on the **Grass Block** item icon.
    *   The square in the middle is on the **Sand** or **Dirt** item icon.
    *   The square to the right is on the **Stone** or **Cobblestone** item icon.

**Conclusion:**
None of the detected regions are "small floating cube particles." Your code is currently triggering false positives on **solid blocks** (grass, logs) and **inventory icons**. There do not appear to be any actual grass/dirt break particles visible in this specific screenshot.
